t: You're in Brixton railway station, looking at Platforms Piece, a group of bronze sculptures of commuters by the artist Kevin Atherton. The first three were finished in 1986, and a fourth figure, called Joy II, was added in 2023. Atherton works in performance, sculpture, film, video and site-specific public art. He was born in 1950 and is now based in Hastings. Notice how the figures stand among the real passengers, as if they're waiting for the same train.
